title: Model links recorded in governed Link Registry
test_intent: Determine whether every model link participating in coordination is represented in the governed Link Registry before coordination intake.

applicability.applies_when: A model or federation contains one or more governed model links intended for coordination intake.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The tested subject contains no governed model links and is not entering a coordination intake that requires linked references.

required_evidence: observed model-link inventory from the tested subject
governed Link Registry entries applicable to the tested project and model
coordination intake identity or state showing the test is performed before or at intake

result_logic.pass: Every observed governed model link has a matching applicable Link Registry entry before coordination intake, with no unregistered participating links.
result_logic.fail: One or more observed governed model links lack a matching applicable Link Registry entry at coordination intake.
result_logic.not_applicable: No governed model links participate in the tested coordination intake.
result_logic.indeterminate: The model-link inventory, applicable Link Registry, or coordination-intake context is unavailable or cannot be matched reliably.

provenance.migration_note: First conformance pilot ATS derived directly from the existing S6 requirement and governed Link Registry relationship.
